info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Petadoption Pets Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Pet Adoption Status Retrieval API enables users to access the current status of pets available for adoption. Through this endpoint, consumers can retrieve essential information about various pets, which facilitates informed decisions during the adoption process. This API is particularly useful for shelters, foster organizations, and potential adopters who seek to understand which pets are available and their corresponding statuses. By providing easy access to this data, the API supports transparency and enhances the pet adoption experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of all pets.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of all registered pets in the system. It provides information about their health, availability, and any other relevant statuses.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the status of the pets to be retrieved. Ensure that the status parameter is correctly defined in accordance with the expected values to filter the pets appropriately.
